Metadata.title: Ride & Vibe
Metadata.description: Istanbul's motorcycle club. Weekend rides, long tours and new friendships, open to riders of every age. Apply to join.

Home.title: <line>Let's ride</line> <line>together.</line>
Home.subtitle: Weekend rides, long tours and new friendships. Meet riders from every side of Istanbul, from Asia to Europe.
Home.heroAlt: Club members taking a break on a coastal road, the sea behind them

rides.title: On the road at weekends, together on weekdays
rides.weekend: When the weather allows, we ride as a group every weekend. A ride takes half a day or a full day depending on the route, and now and then we plan tours of several days.
rides.weekday: On weekdays, members who live nearby meet at a café to catch up, usually by the sea:
rides.alt: Club members at night on the Üsküdar shore, the Maiden's Tower behind them

who.title: Every age, every bike
who.body: Some of us are in our twenties, some in our forties. Any bike, any licence; new riders, women riders and pillion passengers without a bike of their own ride with us too.
who.conditions: Some events may have conditions, such as a bike class.
who.alt: Group photo on a café terrace during a ride break

join.title: From application to the main group
join.step1Body: Fill in the form; it takes a few minutes.
join.step2Body: The club team reviews your application.
join.step3Body: For a few days we get to know each other in a separate group.

rules.body: We're not here to go fast. Helmets are mandatory; we recommend a jacket, gloves and boots. We keep the convoy in order: a safe distance and no overtaking without the go-ahead. We follow the traffic rules and treat each other with respect.
rules.motto: We leave together and we come back together.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: I don't have a motorcycle. Can I join?
faq.q2: I'm a new rider. Is that a problem?
faq.a2: No. The convoy rides at a pace that suits everyone; nobody gets left behind.
faq.q3: Can I join rides without being a member?
faq.a3: Rides are for members. Apply; once you're approved, you can join some rides while you're in the getting-to-know group.

closing.line: A family of people who share the same road.
closing.alt: Club members at a long breakfast table in Kanlıca

inApp.title: Google sign-in doesn't work inside {app}
inApp.body: Google doesn't allow sign-in in in-app browsers. Open the ⋯ menu at the top right and choose "Open in browser", or copy the link and paste it into Safari/Chrome.
inApp.copyManually: Press and hold to copy the link:

Account.title: My account
Account.pendingBody: You're signed in, but an admin hasn't approved your account yet. Once approved, you'll get access to everything.
Account.notAppliedBody: Fill in the application form to become a member. Your details are filled in for you. If you already applied with another email, don't apply again; message us on WhatsApp and we'll link your account.
Account.underReviewBody: Once it's approved, your account moves into the club's probation period.
Account.probationBody: The club is getting to know you; the member list opens once you're a full member.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: You can delete your account and your data in this app.
delete.removed: What gets deleted: your profile, contact details, motorcycles, emergency contacts, blood type, preferences and application.
delete.kept: What stays: a rejected application is kept until its 6 months are up; access records that don't identify you remain. Deleted data may stay in encrypted backups for up to 14 more days.
delete.keptInactive: If you have an approved application, it's kept for 1 year from this request because your membership has ended.
delete.grace: Sign in again within 14 days to get your account back; after that it's deleted for good.
delete.club: Your club membership and the WhatsApp groups aren't affected.
delete.doneBody: It will be deleted for good after {date}. Changed your mind? Just sign in again before then.
delete.lastAdmin: You're the club's only admin. Give the admin role to someone else first.
delete.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

recovery.title: Your account will be deleted
recovery.body: It will be deleted for good after {date}. Restore it and everything stays as it was.
recovery.error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

bloodType.title: Blood type
bloodType.intro: You can add your blood type if you like. It is stored only with your explicit consent and is visible only to the club's safety team.
bloodType.consentLabel: I give my explicit consent for the club's safety team to see my blood type, so that it can be passed to medical teams in an accident or emergency and suitable donors can be found within the club when blood is needed. I can withdraw this consent at any time from my profile.
bloodType.withdrawConfirm: Your blood type will be deleted and the safety team will no longer see it. Are you sure?

google.hint: Your name and email are filled in automatically.

notes.label: New note
notes.hint: Members never see notes in the app. Under KVKK they can ask for the data held about them; a note's content may then be shared, never its author's name. So write what you saw, not opinions.

roles.intro: Roles decide who can do what. Each member has at most one role; members without a role only see the member area. Assign roles on the “Members & access” page.
roles.adminDescription: Has every permission. Only admins can edit roles and assign them. This role cannot be changed or deleted.

view.label: View applications
view.description: Can see the application list and applicant details.

review.label: Review applications
review.description: Can mark applications as contacted and add notes.

delete.label: Delete applications
delete.description: Permanently deletes an application (KVKK erasure requests).

manage.label: Manage members
manage.description: Can see pending sign-ups and move members into probation and activate/deactivate them (except admins).

safety.label: See safety information
safety.description: Can see members' emergency contacts, blood type and plates, and search by blood type.

notes.label: Read and write member notes
notes.description: Can read and write internal staff notes about members; the member never sees them. Notes about admin accounts are visible to admins only.

manage.label: Manage events
manage.description: Creates, edits and cancels meet-ups and rides.

review.title: Review
review.approveBody: {name} is moved into probation automatically when they sign in with Google using this email ({email}); if they use another account, link it with “Link to account”. Send the WhatsApp invite after approving.
review.approveBodyLinked: The linked account {account} is moved into probation right away (as {name}). Let them know on WhatsApp after approving.
review.approveBodyLinkedUnknown: {name} is moved into probation right away through the linked account. Let them know on WhatsApp after approving.
review.approveBodyLinkedInactive: The linked account {account} is inactive; approving doesn't move it into probation. Move it there on the Members page if needed.
review.reopenBody: The application goes back to “Contacted”. An account that is already in probation or active stays as it is; deactivate it on the Members page if needed.
review.notesHint: Only staff who can see applications see this. Write facts only (KVKK).
review.noPermission: You don't have permission to change this application's status.
review.emailMismatch: Heads up: the application was made with {appEmail}, but the linked account's email is {accountEmail}. Before approving, confirm that the person uses this account.
review.emailMismatchDecided: Heads up: the application was made with {appEmail}, but the linked account's email is {accountEmail}. Make sure this account belongs to the applicant.
review.notLinked: Hasn't signed in yet. Send the invite; they are moved into probation automatically when they sign in with the email from the application. If they signed in with a different Google account, link it with “Link to account”.
review.notLinkedNoLink: Hasn't signed in yet. Send the invite; they are moved into probation automatically when they sign in with the email from the application.
review.deleteBody: For KVKK erasure requests. This cannot be undone.

contactEdit.duplicateEmail: Another open application already uses this email.

link.emptyApproved: No pending account or member without an application found.
link.confirm: Link the application of {application} to the account {account}? If the application is approved, the account is moved into probation.
link.confirmAttach: Link the application of {application} to the account {account}? The account is already a member (in probation or active); only the application gets attached to it.

link.invalid: This application or account can no longer be linked. Refresh the page and try again.

Install.bannerTitle: Add Ride & Vibe to your home screen
Install.bannerBody: Opens with one tap, full screen.

ios-safari.1: Tap Share in Safari (iOS 26: tap ••• first).
ios-safari.3: Keep "Open as Web App" on and tap Add.

ios-other.1: Tap Share in the address bar or the menu.

android-manual.2: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

desktop-safari.1: Open File in the menu bar.
